name: Sites of Human Evolution at Mount Carmel: The Nahal Me’arot / Wadi el-Mughara Caves
description: On the western slopes of Mount Carmel near Haifa, four caves (Tabun, Jamal, el-Wad and Skhul) hold deposits spanning at least 500,000 years of human presence. Neanderthals and early modern humans both left tools here in the same Mousterian tradition. Later Natufian burials and early stone buildings mark the shift from hunting and gathering toward farming. Today the caves sit within a nature reserve.
